en.text: God, don’t keep silent. Don’t keep silent, and don’t be still, God.

zhSimplified.text: 神啊，求你不要静默！ 神啊，求你不要闭口，也不要不作声！

zhTraditional.text: 上帝啊，求你不要靜默！ 上帝啊，求你不要閉口，也不要不作聲！

en.text: For, behold, your enemies are stirred up. Those who hate you have lifted up their heads.

zhSimplified.text: 因为你的仇敌喧嚷， 恨你的抬起头来。

zhTraditional.text: 因為你的仇敵喧嚷， 恨你的抬起頭來。

en.text: They conspire with cunning against your people. They plot against your cherished ones.

zhSimplified.text: 他们同谋奸诈要害你的百姓， 彼此商议要害你所隐藏的人。

zhTraditional.text: 他們同謀奸詐要害你的百姓， 彼此商議要害你所隱藏的人。

en.text: “Come,” they say, “let’s destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel may be remembered no more.”

zhSimplified.text: 他们说：来吧，我们将他们剪灭， 使他们不再成国！ 使以色列的名不再被人记念！

zhTraditional.text: 他們說：來吧，我們將他們剪滅， 使他們不再成國！ 使以色列的名不再被人記念！

en.text: For they have conspired together with one mind. They form an alliance against you.

zhSimplified.text: 他们同心商议， 彼此结盟，要抵挡你，

zhTraditional.text: 他們同心商議， 彼此結盟，要抵擋你，

en.text: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagrites;

zhSimplified.text: 就是住帐棚的以东人和以实玛利人， 摩押和夏甲人，

zhTraditional.text: 就是住帳棚的以東人和以實瑪利人， 摩押和夏甲人，

en.text: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;

zhSimplified.text: 迦巴勒、亚扪， 和亚玛力、非利士并泰尔的居民。

zhTraditional.text: 迦巴勒、亞捫， 和亞瑪力、非利士並泰爾的居民。

en.text: Assyria also is joined with them. They have helped the children of Lot. Selah.

zhSimplified.text: 亚述也与他们连合； 他们作罗得子孙的帮手。 （细拉）

zhTraditional.text: 亞述也與他們連合； 他們作羅得子孫的幫手。（細拉）

en.text: Do to them as you did to Midian, as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;

zhSimplified.text: 求你待他们，如待米甸， 如在基顺河待西西拉和耶宾一样。

zhTraditional.text: 求你待他們，如待米甸， 如在基順河待西西拉和耶賓一樣。

en.text: who perished at Endor, who became as dung for the earth.

zhSimplified.text: 他们在隐·多珥灭亡， 成了地上的粪土。

zhTraditional.text: 他們在隱‧多珥滅亡， 成了地上的糞土。

en.text: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, yes, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,

zhSimplified.text: 求你叫他们的首领像俄立和西伊伯， 叫他们的王子都像西巴和撒慕拿。

zhTraditional.text: 求你叫他們的首領像俄立和西伊伯， 叫他們的王子都像西巴和撒慕拿。

en.text: who said, “Let’s take possession of God’s pasture lands.”

zhSimplified.text: 他们说：我们要得 神的住处， 作为自己的产业。

zhTraditional.text: 他們說：我們要得上帝的住處， 作為自己的產業。

en.text: My God, make them like tumbleweed, like chaff before the wind.

zhSimplified.text: 我的 神啊，求你叫他们像旋风的尘土， 像风前的碎秸。

zhTraditional.text: 我的上帝啊，求你叫他們像旋風的塵土， 像風前的碎稭。

en.text: As the fire that burns the forest, as the flame that sets the mountains on fire,

zhSimplified.text: 火怎样焚烧树林， 火焰怎样烧着山岭，

zhTraditional.text: 火怎樣焚燒樹林， 火焰怎樣燒着山嶺，

en.text: so pursue them with your tempest, and terrify them with your storm.

zhSimplified.text: 求你也照样用狂风追赶他们， 用暴雨恐吓他们。

zhTraditional.text: 求你也照樣用狂風追趕他們， 用暴雨恐嚇他們。

en.text: Fill their faces with confusion, that they may seek your name, LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 愿你使他们满面羞耻， 好叫他们寻求你—耶和华的名！

zhTraditional.text: 願你使他們滿面羞恥， 好叫他們尋求你－耶和華的名！

en.text: Let them be disappointed and dismayed forever. Yes, let them be confounded and perish;

zhSimplified.text: 愿他们永远羞愧惊惶！ 愿他们惭愧灭亡！

zhTraditional.text: 願他們永遠羞愧驚惶！ 願他們慚愧滅亡！

en.text: that they may know that you alone, whose name is the LORD, are the Most High over all the earth.

footnotes.text: 83:18 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

zhSimplified.text: 使他们知道：惟独你— 名为耶和华的—是全地以上的至高者！

zhTraditional.text: 使他們知道：惟獨你－ 名為耶和華的－是全地以上的至高者！
